C02 supplies the chronic-unemployment and area-redevelopment context echoed in the child's recitals, yet it is a policy explanation vetoing legislation and contains no comparable operative food-distribution provisions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"make available for distribution, through appropriate State and local agencies, to all needy families a greater variety and quantity of food","parent_excerpt":"offer the Soviet Government shipments of food for distribution to the population of East Germany","explanation":"C17 shares the concrete idea of government-provided food distribution to a population in need, but the setting, instrument, implementing actors, and operative machinery differ too substantially to establish a drafting template."},{"child_excerpt":"special emphasis is placed upon the need for additional food to supplement the diets of needy persons in areas of chronic unemployment","parent_excerpt":"families, both farm and non-farm, living in rural areas have relatively low cash incomes","explanation":"C25 shares a recital focused on economically disadvantaged families and state-local cooperation, but its committee-creation structure is not reused by the child."},{"child_excerpt":"areas of chronic unemployment","parent_excerpt":"communities of substantial and persistent unemployment","explanation":"C02 contains closely related area-redevelopment terminology, but this reflects a shared policy problem rather than copied language or administrative machinery for food distribution."}]}
